fields.label: Summary

fields.instructions: One or two sentences. Shown on cards and as the intro paragraph of the article.

fields.label: Featured
fields.name: featured
fields.message: Show in “Start here” on the Resources page

fields.label: Related resources
fields.name: related_resources
fields.instructions: Up to four. Leave empty to show the newest resources in the same topic.

fields.label: SEO H1
fields.name: seo_h1
fields.instructions: Keyword-led heading. When set it becomes the H1 and the post title renders as the H2 beneath it.

fields.label: SEO title
fields.name: seo_title
fields.instructions: The browser/search title, written in full (e.g. “VAC disability ratings: How they work | 270 West”). Leave empty to use the post title.
